description:
Read which V1 data surfaces the API serves for Polymarket, the one venue it covers. Every surface reports the status supported: grade, pnl, strategy, timeline, large_trades, whale_signal (the deprecated spelling of large_trades), suspicious_trades, insider_radar (the deprecated spelling of suspicious_trades), and market_snapshot. Use this before choosing trader, market, large-trade, or suspicious-trade routes.

Args: none

Returns: Static backend-owned coverage document under the single key polymarket.
name: get_coverage
title: Get coverage
